note: [agent-bulk] shw 30003 (120.8 MeV, 7 seg, pdg 11, nuecc): correct -- nothing contiguous is missing. Members run from the nu vertex (seed 30003, 6.5 cm) out to 62.4 cm, all within 23.5 deg of the axis and all inside the pass-1 acceptance window. The only unclaimed in-cone object is 97019 at 22.3 cm / 5.4 deg, tier 1, sitting inside the acceptance band on the acc plot -- but it is a 1.7 MeV single-point stub (0.15 cm), 1.4 pct of the shower, so no IN mark: a mark would overstate it. Shower 99021 (16.2 MeV, 2.6 cm) is at 33.4 cm / 35.2 deg, outside the cone and off the top of the acceptance plot, correctly left to itself. Segment 30004 (22.7 cm, pdg 13, dist 0 / angle 0) is grey/unowned at the vertex -- the second prong of the nuecc vertex, correctly not absorbed. Vertex looks good: the star is where 30004 and the shower seed converge. Residual doubt, stated: the member set has a ~26 cm internal gap between 22.7 and 48.8 cm, so an over-clustered reading (vertex stem plus a detached downstream group fused by pass4_angle / pass4_proximity) is not excluded; I did not resolve it, and 62 cm is a normal extent for a 120 MeV EM shower in LAr. Showers NOT looked at: the 10 the scope rule skipped (69016 18.1 MeV, 99021 16.2 MeV, and 8 more all under 3.1 MeV) -- all below the 20 MeV threshold. Clustering statement, silent on PID.
